imo-1970-q1.summary: Let $M$ be an interior point of side $AB$ of triangle $ABC$. Let $r_1,r_2,r$ be the inradii of triangles $ACM,BCM,ABC$, and let $\rho_1,\rho_2,\rho$ be the exradii of those triangles opposite $C$ (their excircles lie in angle $ACB$). Prove that $\frac{r_1}{\rho_1}\frac{r_2}{\rho_2}=\frac r\rho$.
imo-1970-q1.summaryZh: 设 $M$ 是三角形 $ABC$ 的边 $AB$ 上的内点。令 $r_1,r_2,r$ 分别为三角形 $ACM,BCM,ABC$ 的内切圆半径，$\rho_1,\rho_2,\rho$ 分别为这三个三角形中顶点 $C$ 所对的旁切圆半径（相应旁切圆位于角 $ACB$ 内）。证明 $\frac{r_1}{\rho_1}\frac{r_2}{\rho_2}=\frac r\rho$。

methods.title: Cancel complementary half-angle factors
methods.titleZh: 消去互余角的半角因子
steps: First establish a triangle lemma. In a nondegenerate triangle $XYZ$, let the angles at $X,Y$ be $\alpha,\beta$, let the inradius be $u$, and let the exradius opposite $Z$ be $v$. Then $u/v=\tan(\alpha/2)\tan(\beta/2)$.

To prove the lemma, drop perpendiculars from the incenter and the $Z$-excenter to $XY$. The two decompositions of $XY$ give $XY=u(\cot(\alpha/2)+\cot(\beta/2))$ and $XY=v(\tan(\alpha/2)+\tan(\beta/2))$. Dividing and simplifying yields the stated ratio.
Write $\alpha=\angle CAB$, $\beta=\angle CBA$, and $\theta=\angle AMC$. Applying the lemma to $ACM$ gives $r_1/\rho_1=\tan(\alpha/2)\tan(\theta/2)$.
Because $A,M,B$ are collinear, $\angle BMC=180^\circ-\theta$. Hence the lemma applied to $BCM$ gives $r_2/\rho_2=\tan(\beta/2)\tan(90^\circ-\theta/2)=\tan(\beta/2)\cot(\theta/2)$.
Multiplication cancels the two $\theta$-factors: $(r_1/\rho_1)(r_2/\rho_2)=\tan(\alpha/2)\tan(\beta/2)$. Applying the lemma once more to $ABC$ identifies the last expression as $r/\rho$.
stepsZh: 先证明一个三角形引理。在非退化三角形 $XYZ$ 中，设 $X,Y$ 处的角为 $\alpha,\beta$，内切圆半径为 $u$，顶点 $Z$ 所对的旁切圆半径为 $v$，则 $u/v=\tan(\alpha/2)\tan(\beta/2)$。
证明引理：分别从内心和 $Z$-旁心向 $XY$ 作垂线。由角平分线形成的直角三角形，线段 $XY$ 有两种分解：$XY=u(\cot(\alpha/2)+\cot(\beta/2))$ 与 $XY=v(\tan(\alpha/2)+\tan(\beta/2))$。两式相除并化简即得引理。
记 $\alpha=\angle CAB$、$\beta=\angle CBA$、$\theta=\angle AMC$。对 $ACM$ 应用引理，得到 $r_1/\rho_1=\tan(\alpha/2)\tan(\theta/2)$。
由于 $A,M,B$ 共线，$\angle BMC=180^\circ-\theta$。对 $BCM$ 应用引理，得到 $r_2/\rho_2=\tan(\beta/2)\tan(90^\circ-\theta/2)=\tan(\beta/2)\cot(\theta/2)$。
两式相乘后，关于 $\theta$ 的两个因子恰好抵消：$(r_1/\rho_1)(r_2/\rho_2)=\tan(\alpha/2)\tan(\beta/2)$。再对 $ABC$ 应用一次引理，最后一式正是 $r/\rho$。

imo-1970-q2.summary: The same digits $x_0,x_1,\ldots,x_n$ are valid in bases $a$ and $b$, with $x_0x_1\ne0$. Let $A_n=\overline{x_1x_2\cdots x_n}^{(a)}$, $A_{n+1}=\overline{x_0x_1\cdots x_n}^{(a)}$, and define $B_n,B_{n+1}$ analogously in base $b$. Prove that $a>b$ if and only if $A_n/A_{n+1}<B_n/B_{n+1}$.
imo-1970-q2.summaryZh: 同一组数字 $x_0,x_1,\ldots,x_n$ 在 $a,b$ 两种进位制中均合法，且 $x_0x_1\ne0$。令 $A_n=\overline{x_1x_2\cdots x_n}^{(a)}$、$A_{n+1}=\overline{x_0x_1\cdots x_n}^{(a)}$，并在 $b$ 进制中类似定义 $B_n,B_{n+1}$。证明：$a>b$ 当且仅当 $A_n/A_{n+1}<B_n/B_{n+1}$。

methods.title: Normalize the suffix and use monotonicity
methods.titleZh: 归一化尾部数字并利用单调性
steps: For $t>0$, define $S(t)=\sum_{j=1}^{n}x_j/t^j$. Every digit is nonnegative and $x_1>0$, so $S(t)>0$ and $S$ is strictly decreasing: when $s>t$, every summand at $s$ is no larger, while the $j=1$ summand is strictly smaller.
Positional notation gives $A_n=a^nS(a)$ and $A_{n+1}=a^n(x_0+S(a))$. Thus $A_n/A_{n+1}=S(a)/(x_0+S(a))$. Similarly, $B_n/B_{n+1}=S(b)/(x_0+S(b))$.
Since all quantities are positive and $x_0>0$, cross-multiplication shows $S(a)/(x_0+S(a))<S(b)/(x_0+S(b))$ if and only if $x_0S(a)<x_0S(b)$, hence if and only if $S(a)<S(b)$.
The strict decrease of $S$ turns the final inequality into $a>b$. Reversing every equivalence proves both directions of the required statement.
stepsZh: 对 $t>0$，定义 $S(t)=\sum_{j=1}^{n}x_j/t^j$。各位数字非负且 $x_1>0$，所以 $S(t)>0$，并且 $S$ 严格递减：若 $s>t$，每一项在 $s$ 处都不大于在 $t$ 处的值，而 $j=1$ 项严格变小。
所有量均为正且 $x_0>0$，交叉相乘可得 $S(a)/(x_0+S(a))<S(b)/(x_0+S(b))$ 当且仅当 $x_0S(a)<x_0S(b)$，也就是当且仅当 $S(a)<S(b)$。
由于 $S$ 严格递减，最后一个不等式等价于 $a>b$。上述每一步均为等价变形，因此两个方向同时得证。

imo-1970-q3.summary: Let $1=a_0\le a_1\le a_2\le\cdots$ be real numbers and define $b_n=\sum_{k=1}^{n}(1-a_{k-1}/a_k)/\sqrt{a_k}$. (a) Prove $0\le b_n<2$. (b) For every $0\le c<2$, construct such a sequence for which $b_n>c$ for infinitely many $n$.
imo-1970-q3.summaryZh: 设实数列满足 $1=a_0\le a_1\le a_2\le\cdots$，并定义 $b_n=\sum_{k=1}^{n}(1-a_{k-1}/a_k)/\sqrt{a_k}$。（a）证明 $0\le b_n<2$。（b）对任意 $0\le c<2$，构造这样的数列，使 $b_n>c$ 对无穷多个 $n$ 成立。
imo-1970-q3.answer: Always $0\le b_n<2$; for part (b), one may take $a_k=r^{-2k}$ with $r=(c+1)/3$.

methods.title: Telescoping bound and a geometric construction
methods.titleZh: 伸缩求和估计与等比构造
steps: Set $x_k=1/\sqrt{a_k}$. Then $1=x_0\ge x_1\ge x_2\ge\cdots>0$. The $k$th summand becomes $x_k(1-x_k^2/x_{k-1}^2)=(x_{k-1}-x_k)(x_k/x_{k-1})(1+x_k/x_{k-1})$.
Because $0<x_k/x_{k-1}\le1$, each summand is nonnegative and at most $2(x_{k-1}-x_k)$. Therefore $0\le b_n\le2\sum_{k=1}^{n}(x_{k-1}-x_k)=2(1-x_n)<2$, proving part (a).
For part (b), fix $0\le c<2$ and put $r=(c+1)/3$. Then $0<r<1$ and $r(1+r)-c=(2-c)^2/9>0$.
Choose $a_k=r^{-2k}$. This is increasing and begins with $a_0=1$. Moreover, $a_{k-1}/a_k=r^2$ and $1/\sqrt{a_k}=r^k$, so $b_n=(1-r^2)\sum_{k=1}^{n}r^k=r(1+r)(1-r^n)$.
As $n\to\infty$, the last expression tends to $r(1+r)>c$. Hence $b_n>c$ for all sufficiently large $n$, which is stronger than requiring infinitely many such indices.
stepsZh: 因为 $0<x_k/x_{k-1}\le1$，每个被加数非负且不超过 $2(x_{k-1}-x_k)$。因此 $0\le b_n\le2\sum_{k=1}^{n}(x_{k-1}-x_k)=2(1-x_n)<2$，（a）得证。
当 $n\to\infty$ 时，上式趋于 $r(1+r)>c$。因此所有充分大的 $n$ 都满足 $b_n>c$，这比题目要求的“无穷多个”更强。

imo-1970-q4.summary: Determine all positive integers $n$ for which the six numbers $n,n+1,\ldots,n+5$ can be partitioned into two sets having equal products.
imo-1970-q4.summaryZh: 求所有正整数 $n$，使六个数 $n,n+1,\ldots,n+5$ 可以分成两个子集，且两个子集中各数之积相等。
imo-1970-q4.answerZh: 不存在满足条件的正整数 $n$。

methods.title: Order bounds reduce the partition to four cases
methods.titleZh: 用乘积大小关系化为四种情形
steps: Assume a valid partition exists. For $n=1$, exactly one of $1,2,3,4,5,6$ is divisible by $5$, so the two products cannot be equal. Hence it remains to consider $n\ge2$.

Each part must contain three numbers. Otherwise one part has at most two and the other at least four; their products are at most $(n+4)(n+5)$ and at least $n(n+1)(n+2)(n+3)$ respectively. For $n\ge2$, $n(n+1)\ge n+4$ and $(n+2)(n+3)>n+5$, so equality is impossible.

The numbers $n$ and $n+5$ must lie in the same part. If not, the part containing $n$ has product at most $n(n+3)(n+4)$, while the other has product at least $(n+1)(n+2)(n+5)$; the latter is larger because $n(n+3)<(n+1)(n+2)$ and $n+4<n+5$.
Thus one part is $\{n,n+k,n+5\}$ for $k\in\{1,2,3,4\}$. If $k=1$ or $2$, its product is at most $n(n+2)(n+5)<(n+1)(n+3)(n+4)$, a lower bound for the complementary product.

Finally, $k=3$ would require $n(n+3)(n+5)=(n+1)(n+2)(n+4)$. Expansion reduces this to $n(n+1)=8$, impossible because it equals $6$ at $n=2$ and is at least $12$ for $n\ge3$. Hence no positive integer works.
stepsZh: 反设存在合适的划分。当 $n=1$ 时，$1,2,3,4,5,6$ 中恰有一个数能被 $5$ 整除，因此两个乘积不可能相等。以下只需考虑 $n\ge2$。
每个子集必须恰含三个数。否则一边至多含两个数，另一边至少含四个数；前者乘积至多为 $(n+4)(n+5)$，后者至少为 $n(n+1)(n+2)(n+3)$。当 $n\ge2$ 时，$n(n+1)\ge n+4$ 且 $(n+2)(n+3)>n+5$，故两乘积不可能相等。
$n$ 与 $n+5$ 必须在同一子集中。否则含 $n$ 的一边乘积至多为 $n(n+3)(n+4)$，另一边至少为 $(n+1)(n+2)(n+5)$；由 $n(n+3)<(n+1)(n+2)$ 及 $n+4<n+5$，后者严格更大。
因此其中一个子集必为 $\{n,n+k,n+5\}$，其中 $k\in\{1,2,3,4\}$。若 $k=1$ 或 $2$，该边乘积至多为 $n(n+2)(n+5)<(n+1)(n+3)(n+4)$，而右侧又是另一边乘积的下界。
最后，$k=3$ 要求 $n(n+3)(n+5)=(n+1)(n+2)(n+4)$。展开化简得到 $n(n+1)=8$；但 $n=2$ 时左侧为 $6$，$n\ge3$ 时左侧至少为 $12$，均不可能。因此不存在满足条件的正整数。

imo-1970-q5.summary: In tetrahedron $ABCD$, $BD\perp CD$. The perpendicular projection $H$ of $D$ onto plane $ABC$ is the orthocentre of triangle $ABC$. Prove $(AB+BC+CA)^2\le6(AD^2+BD^2+CD^2)$ and determine the equality cases.
imo-1970-q5.summaryZh: 在四面体 $ABCD$ 中，$BD\perp CD$。点 $D$ 在平面 $ABC$ 上的垂足 $H$ 是三角形 $ABC$ 的垂心。证明 $(AB+BC+CA)^2\le6(AD^2+BD^2+CD^2)$，并求等号成立的情形。
imo-1970-q5.answer: Equality holds exactly when $DA,DB,DC$ are pairwise perpendicular and $DA=DB=DC$.
imo-1970-q5.answerZh: 等号成立当且仅当 $DA,DB,DC$ 两两垂直且 $DA=DB=DC$。

methods.title: Use vectors to reveal a tri-rectangular tetrahedron
methods.titleZh: 用向量揭示三直角四面体结构
steps: Take $D$ as the origin and write $\mathbf a=\overrightarrow{DA}$, $\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{DB}$, $\mathbf c=\overrightarrow{DC}$, and $\mathbf h=\overrightarrow{DH}$.

Since $DH\perp ABC$, $\mathbf h\cdot(\mathbf b-\mathbf c)=0$. Since $AH$ is an altitude of $ABC$, $(\mathbf a-\mathbf h)\cdot(\mathbf b-\mathbf c)=0$. Adding these relations gives $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf c$.

Applying the same argument to the altitude through $B$ gives $\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf a=\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c$. Hence all three pairwise dot products are equal. The condition $BD\perp CD$ says $\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c=0$, so $\mathbf a,\mathbf b,\mathbf c$ are pairwise perpendicular.
Pythagoras now gives $AB^2=AD^2+BD^2$, $BC^2=BD^2+CD^2$, and $CA^2=CD^2+AD^2$. Therefore, by Cauchy-Schwarz, $(AB+BC+CA)^2\le3(AB^2+BC^2+CA^2)=6(AD^2+BD^2+CD^2)$.

Equality in Cauchy-Schwarz holds exactly when $AB=BC=CA$. Subtracting the three Pythagorean identities shows that this is equivalent to $AD=BD=CD$. Together with the already proved pairwise perpendicularity, these are the necessary equality conditions.

They are also sufficient. For $t>0$, take $D=(0,0,0)$, $A=(t,0,0)$, $B=(0,t,0)$, $C=(0,0,t)$. Plane $ABC$ is $x+y+z=t$, and the perpendicular foot $H=(t/3,t/3,t/3)$ lies on all three altitudes of the equilateral triangle $ABC$. Thus all hypotheses and equality are attained.
stepsZh: 以 $D$ 为原点，记 $\mathbf a=\overrightarrow{DA}$、$\mathbf b=\overrightarrow{DB}$、$\mathbf c=\overrightarrow{DC}$、$\mathbf h=\overrightarrow{DH}$。
因为 $DH\perp ABC$，有 $\mathbf h\cdot(\mathbf b-\mathbf c)=0$。又因 $AH$ 是三角形 $ABC$ 的高，$(\mathbf a-\mathbf h)\cdot(\mathbf b-\mathbf c)=0$。两式相加得到 $\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf b=\mathbf a\cdot\mathbf c$。
对从 $B$ 引出的高作同样论证，得到 $\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf a=\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c$。因此三个两两数量积相等。条件 $BD\perp CD$ 给出 $\mathbf b\cdot\mathbf c=0$，所以 $\mathbf a,\mathbf b,\mathbf c$ 两两垂直。
由勾股定理，$AB^2=AD^2+BD^2$、$BC^2=BD^2+CD^2$、$CA^2=CD^2+AD^2$。再由柯西—施瓦茨不等式，$(AB+BC+CA)^2\le3(AB^2+BC^2+CA^2)=6(AD^2+BD^2+CD^2)$。
柯西—施瓦茨不等式取等当且仅当 $AB=BC=CA$。将三个勾股等式两两相减可知，这等价于 $AD=BD=CD$。结合已证的两两垂直性，得到等号成立的必要条件。
这些条件也充分。对任意 $t>0$，取 $D=(0,0,0)$、$A=(t,0,0)$、$B=(0,t,0)$、$C=(0,0,t)$。平面 $ABC$ 为 $x+y+z=t$，从 $D$ 作垂线的垂足 $H=(t/3,t/3,t/3)$ 位于等边三角形 $ABC$ 的三条高上，因此题设与等号均成立。

imo-1970-q6.summary: Among 100 points in the plane, no three collinear, consider all triangles with vertices chosen from the points. Prove that at most $70\%$ of these triangles are acute.
imo-1970-q6.summaryZh: 平面上有 $100$ 个点，任意三点不共线。考虑以这些点为顶点的所有三角形，证明其中至多 $70\%$ 是锐角三角形。
imo-1970-q6.answer: The number of acute triangles is at most $\frac7{10}\binom{100}{3}$.
imo-1970-q6.answerZh: 锐角三角形的数量至多为 $\frac7{10}\binom{100}{3}$。

methods.title: A four-point lemma followed by double counting
steps: Call a triangle non-acute if it has an angle at least $90^\circ$. Any four of the points determine a non-acute triangle. If their convex hull is a quadrilateral, one interior angle is at least $90^\circ$, and its vertex with the two neighboring vertices forms such a triangle.

If instead the convex hull of the four points is a triangle $ABC$, the fourth point $P$ lies strictly inside it. The angles $\angle APB,\angle BPC,\angle CPA$ sum to $360^\circ$, so one is at least $120^\circ$; the corresponding triangle is non-acute. This proves the four-point lemma.

Take any five points and let $m$ be their number of non-acute triangles. Each of the five four-point subsets contains at least one by the lemma. Each fixed triangle lies in exactly two of these four-point subsets, obtained by adjoining either remaining point. Hence $2m\ge5$, so the integer $m$ satisfies $m\ge3$.

Let $N$ be the total number of non-acute triangles among the 100 points. Count pairs $(T,S)$ in which $S$ is a five-point subset and $T$ is a non-acute triangle contained in $S$. The five-point count gives at least $3\binom{100}{5}$ pairs.
Every fixed triangle belongs to exactly $\binom{97}{2}$ five-point subsets. Thus $N\binom{97}{2}\ge3\binom{100}{5}$, or $N\ge(3/10)\binom{100}{3}$.
There are $\binom{100}{3}$ triangles in total. Consequently the number of acute triangles is at most $\binom{100}{3}-N\le(7/10)\binom{100}{3}$, which is exactly the asserted $70\%$ bound.
stepsZh: 把至少有一个角不小于 $90^\circ$ 的三角形称为非锐角三角形。任意四点必确定一个非锐角三角形。若四点的凸包是四边形，则其某个内角不小于 $90^\circ$，该顶点与相邻两个顶点构成所需三角形。
若四点的凸包是三角形 $ABC$，则第四点 $P$ 严格位于内部。三个角 $\angle APB,\angle BPC,\angle CPA$ 之和为 $360^\circ$，故其中一个至少为 $120^\circ$；相应三角形为非锐角三角形。四点引理得证。
任取五点，设它们确定的非锐角三角形有 $m$ 个。五个四点子集各自至少包含一个这样的三角形；而每个固定三角形恰属于其中两个四点子集，因为可分别加入余下两点。因此 $2m\ge5$，由 $m$ 为整数得 $m\ge3$。
设 100 点确定的非锐角三角形总数为 $N$。二重计数数对 $(T,S)$，其中 $S$ 是五点子集，$T$ 是包含在 $S$ 中的非锐角三角形。由上一步，数对至少有 $3\binom{100}{5}$ 个。
每个固定三角形恰属于 $\binom{97}{2}$ 个五点子集，因此 $N\binom{97}{2}\ge3\binom{100}{5}$，即 $N\ge(3/10)\binom{100}{3}$。
三角形总数为 $\binom{100}{3}$，所以锐角三角形数至多为 $\binom{100}{3}-N\le(7/10)\binom{100}{3}$，恰为所要求的 $70\%$ 上界。
